forever_changes: All six regular healing potions moved from Alchemy to First Aid; Alchemy keeps Discolored Healing Potions, which heal instantly but return 75% of the heal as poison or disease damage over time, and all of them need a Murloc Eye (conquestcapped).
Discolored Healing Potion recipes are unlocked by a short questline: Odd Child in Westfall (Alliance) or Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher, Silverpine Forest (Horde) (Wowhead, conquestcapped).

Starter recipes known at 1: Elixir of Minor Force (1 Silverleaf, 1 Empty Vial) and Elixir of Minor Defense (Silverleaf, Peacebloom, Empty Vial); Minor Mana Potion uses Mageroyal, Peacebloom and an Empty Vial (Wowhead tooltips).

72 new recipes: 29 bought with Merchant's Favor (Azeroth Commerce Authority) from Nina Surefire, Three Corners, Redridge Mountains (Alliance) and Apothecary Durelle, The Barrens (Horde); 15 have no known source (conquestcapped, warcrafttavern).

New Forever-only herbs Marefoil and Demonsage, plus Death Lotus (a chance from any Mount Hyjal herb, only with the Lotus Claw glove enchant), are reagents for the four skill-300 Flasks of Natural Accuracy, Aggression, Precision and Swiftness; their bonus works only in Mount Hyjal, Hyjal Summit and Barrow Deeps. None of them is needed for 1-300 (warcraft.wiki.gg, wow-professions, conquestcapped).
Camp objects: Mana Well (20), Fermenter (140), Alchemy Laboratory (300); the Laboratory is required for every flask (conquestcapped).
No Elixir/Potion/Transmutation Master specializations in Forever; new Recipe: Transmute Legionite at 275 (conquestcapped).
Extra Artisan trainer for both factions: Master Mycologist Shurome, Felwood; Expert trainers Linzy Blackbolt and Patricia Egan added in Alterac Mountains for Alliance (conquestcapped, dving.net).
